verdict.rationale: TruffleHog lets you gate on confidence via verification status — flags like --only-verified, --results=verified,unknown --fail, and --verify-detectors/--no-verify-detectors let CI fail only on high-confidence (verified) secrets, and the probe run confirms JSON output includes a per-finding Verified:true/false field usable for filtering. However there is no evidence of a severity taxonomy or severity-based gating (only a binary verified/unverified confidence signal), so the story is only partially met. Missing for 10: severity levels/scoring, documented severity-based gate thresholds, independent confirmation that verification-based gating meaningfully reduces noise in practice.
